entries.summary: It is licensed under Apache 2.0 and runs in your own GitHub Actions minutes, which are free for public repos and included in every plan for private ones. There is no paid tier, no account and no StackVitals-hosted…

entries.title: StackVitals for an open-source maintainer
entries.summary: You want red CI to stop eating contributors' time, newcomers answered, and fewer surprise dependency breaks. The Action is free on public repos and needs only the built-in token.

entries.title: StackVitals for an engineering manager
entries.summary: You want to know where your team's time goes and whether changes help, without rating people. This is the path.

entries.title: StackVitals for a platform team
entries.summary: You run GitHub for an org and want one view of every repo, owners that are real, standards people can see coming, and a security review you can sign off.
